results.name: placebo_treatment
results.title: Placebo treatment
results.what_it_does: Randomly shuffles which customers were offered the discount, then re-estimates the average effect.
results.expected: A shuffled discount has no real effect, so the estimate should be close to 0.
results.criterion: every placebo average effect must be within +/-0.0210 of 0 (25% of the original effect)

results.name: random_common_cause
results.title: Random common cause
results.what_it_does: Adds a column of random noise as an extra customer attribute, then re-estimates.
results.expected: Noise cannot matter, so the average effect should barely change.
results.criterion: every re-estimate must be within +/-0.0210 of the original (25% of the original effect)

results.name: data_subset
results.title: Data subset
results.what_it_does: Re-estimates on random 80% subsets of the customers.
results.expected: A stable result should not change much when 20% of the customers are left out.
results.criterion: every re-estimate must be within +/-0.0210 of the original (25% of the original effect)

not_done: Sensitivity to an unmeasured confounder (cannot be ruled out from the data).
disclaimer: Passing these tests does not prove the causal assumptions. They can reveal problems (for example an unstable estimate) but cannot rule out unmeasured confounders.
